_doc: R13 remix source manifest: one row per remixed cue. make_sfx.py renders each Seed with EzAudio on the local ComfyUI (comfy.py audio), picks the seed whose loudness envelope best fits a hit then a falling tail (Shape), trims to Seconds from the onset, fades the last FadeSeconds, sets the loudest 300 ms to TargetRmsDb (the synth original's level, so one +CueMix trim fits both) (peak under -1 dBFS) and writes Content/DC/Audio/Source/Sfx_<Cue>.wav, imported as S_Sfx_<Cue>. +CueMix in Config/DefaultGame.ini points the cue at it. Tool input only.

sfx.Prompt: one massive explosion, a deep heavy boom followed by a long low rumbling tail that slowly fades out, far away over a city at night, no music, no voices
a concrete tower collapsing, heavy crumbling rubble and debris falling, deep rumble, dust and small stones settling at the end, no music, no voices
a deep low groan of a steel and concrete building straining under its weight, slow creak, no music, no voices
